conclusions: x equals the real integral of one with respect to volume restricted to (0,x].
ENNReal.ofReal x equals the lower integral over positive t of the ENNReal indicator that is one for t<x.
mathematical_definitions: The first right side is ∫1 d(volume restricted to (0,x]).
The second indicator has effective support (0,x).
ofReal x is the nonnegative extended-real representation of x.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every nonnegative real x, the length of (0,x] is x as a real integral, and the length of (0,x) is x as an ENNReal indicator integral over the positive half-line.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: At x=0 both regions are empty and both identities reduce to zero.
The regions differ at x but the singleton has zero volume.
The second indicator t<x must be combined with the restricted domain t>0.
ambiguities: Restricted-measure notation is equivalent to explicit domain-of-integration notation.
The first equality is Real-valued and the second ENNReal-valued though both encode interval length.
